# DeepEval Feature Gap Analysis for Bitcraft (2026-09)

> Origin: Generated by AI Ops via GLM on 2026-09-18. Human review: pending.

## 1. Research Question

Which DeepEval capabilities fit an AI Tutor platform for academic tutoring, Arduino and technical troubleshooting, and pair-programming tutoring?

The review compares the full DeepEval feature set against the Bitcraft sidecar implementation. It classifies each capability as relevant now, relevant later, or never, and ends with prioritized recommendations and open decisions.

## 2. Evidence: DeepEval Feature Inventory

DeepEval 4.2.3 (2026-09-14, Apache 2.0, Python >= 3.9) provides 50+ metrics. Almost all predefined metrics use an LLM judge. Items marked **[LLM judge]** need a judge model at scoring time (deepeval.com/docs/metrics-introduction).

### Custom metrics

- **G-Eval** [LLM judge]. Scores any natural-language criterion such as correctness or tone. Simplest custom metric (deepeval.com/docs/metrics-llm-evals).
- **DAG (Deep Acyclic Graph)** [LLM judge for leaf nodes]. Breaks complex criteria into a decision tree. Gives deterministic scores (deepeval.com/docs/metrics-dag).
- **Conversational G-Eval / Conversational DAG** [LLM judge]. Same ideas applied to multi-turn conversations.
- **Arena G-Eval** [LLM judge]. Compares outputs from two or more models head to head.
- **DIY metrics**. Subclass `BaseMetric` with any self-coded scorer such as BLEU or ROUGE.

### Agent metrics

- **Task Completion** [LLM judge, needs tracing]. Scores whether the agent finished its task.
- **Step Efficiency** [LLM judge]. Scores avoidance of redundant steps.
- **Plan Adherence / Plan Quality** [LLM judge]. Scores plan following and plan soundness.
- **Tool Correctness / Argument Correctness** [reference-based]. Scores tool choice and tool arguments against a ground truth.

### RAG metrics

- **Answer Relevancy** [LLM judge]. Scores whether the answer addresses the question.
- **Faithfulness** [LLM judge]. Scores factual consistency of the answer against retrieved context.
- **Contextual Precision / Recall / Relevancy** [LLM judge, reference-based for Recall]. Score retriever quality.

### Multi-turn chatbot metrics

- **Conversation Completeness / Conversation Relevancy** [LLM judge]. Score whole-conversation outcome and focus.
- **Role Adherence** [LLM judge]. Scores whether the chatbot stays in character.
- **Knowledge Retention** [LLM judge]. Scores whether facts persist across turns.

### Safety metrics

- **Bias, Toxicity, PIILeakage** [LLM judge]. Detect biased, toxic, or privacy-leaking output.
- **Non-Advice, Misuse, Role Violation** [LLM judge]. Detect out-of-scope advice, harmful use, and persona breaks.
- **DeepTeam** (separate package). Orchestrates red-team attacks against LLMs.

### Multimodal metrics

- **Image Coherence, Image Helpfulness, Image Reference, Text-to-Image, Image-Editing** [LLM judge]. Score image understanding and generation tasks.

### Other metrics

- **Hallucination, JSON Correctness, Summarization, Ragas** [LLM judge for most]. General-purpose checks.

### Platform capabilities

- **Standard benchmarks**. MMLU, GSM8K, BigBenchHard, HellaSwag, DROP, TruthfulQA, HumanEval. They wrap any model through `DeepEvalBaseLLM` (deepeval.com/docs/benchmarks-introduction).
- **Synthetic data generation**. Golden Synthesizer creates single-turn and multi-turn goldens from documents, contexts, or scratch (deepeval.com/docs/golden-synthesizer).
- **Conversation Simulator**. Role-plays a fake user against a chatbot callback and produces `ConversationalTestCase` objects (deepeval.com/docs/conversation-simulator).
- **Prompt optimization**. PromptOptimizer with GEPA and MIPROv2 rewrites prompts from metric feedback (deepeval.com/docs/prompt-optimization-introduction).
- **Tracing and observability**. `@observe` decorators capture traces and spans for trajectory and component-level scoring.
- **Custom judge models**. Any model works through `DeepEvalBaseLLM`, including Ollama.
- **Runner features**. `evaluate()`, pytest integration, thresholds, flaky flags, strict mode, caching, parallel runs, local SQLite storage.
- **Confident AI**. Commercial cloud for reports, dashboards, and online evals.
- **MCP metrics**. Docs list metrics for MCP tool interactions. The dedicated page did not load during research. Verify before planning.

## 3. Grounding to the AI Tutor Domain

### Academic tutoring

- Multi-turn metrics map directly. A tutor must retain knowledge across turns, stay in its tutor role, and complete learning goals. Priority: now (after LLM judge).
- G-Eval fits pedagogy quality criteria such as "explanation matches student level".
- Conversation Simulator can build tutoring scenarios like "student confuses ohms law".

### Arduino and technical troubleshooting

- G-Eval matches the locked four-dimension rubric for technical answers.
- DAG suits deterministic checks. Example: verify a safety warning exists before scoring wiring advice.
- Faithfulness matters most here. A wrong circuit claim can destroy hardware. Score answers against Knowledge retrieval context.
- HumanEval is relevant for code answers but needs a code execution sandbox. Keep it deferred per the locked decision.

### Pair-programming tutoring

- G-Eval on explanation quality and hint quality. Good tutors guide, they do not dump solutions.
- Tool Correctness becomes relevant when tutors call MCP tools during sessions.
- Hallucination checks on code claims protect against invented APIs.

### Classification

- **Relevant now**: G-Eval, Faithfulness, Answer Relevancy, safety metrics, custom judge wiring.
- **Relevant later**: multi-turn metrics, Conversation Simulator, Golden Synthesizer, DAG, Tool Correctness, tracing.
- **Never or defer**: Confident AI cloud (privacy, self-hosted platform), image-editing and text-to-image metrics (no image generation), Arena G-Eval (single-model tutors today), DeepTeam red teaming (defer until safety review asks).

## 4. Gap Analysis

| Feature | DeepEval offers | Bitcraft implemented | Gap severity | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard benchmarks (7 suites) | Yes | Yes. Runner wired end to end with n_problems | None | Maintain. HumanEval stays disabled |
| G-Eval custom criteria | Yes | Yes in `deepeval_metrics.py` but unregistered by product decision | Medium | Register behind a judge model config |
| RAG metrics (relevancy, faithfulness) | Yes, LLM judge | Token-overlap approximation only | High | Implement true metrics once the judge is live |
| Contextual precision/recall/relevancy | Yes, LLM judge | No. Retrieval context not passed to scorer | Medium | Pass tutor retrieval context into test cases |
| Safety metrics (bias, toxicity, PII) | Yes, LLM judge | Keyword and regex approximation | Medium | Keep deterministic scan as fast pass. Add judge pass |
| Multi-turn metrics | Yes | No. Benchmark cases are single-turn | High | Extend tutor benchmark to capture conversation turns |
| Agentic trajectory metrics | Yes, needs tracing | No | Low | Defer. Tutor chat is not a traced agent today |
| Tool Correctness | Yes, reference-based | No | Low | Revisit when tutor MCP tool calls are benchmarked |
| MCP metrics | Yes | No | Low | Revisit with tool-calling evaluation |
| Multimodal image metrics | Yes | No. Image input exists, image eval does not | Low | Defer. Needs a validated image-tutor use case |
| Conversation Simulator | Yes | No | Medium | Use to seed multi-turn tutoring scenarios |
| Golden Synthesizer | Yes | No. Manual case authoring | Medium | Use on Documents to seed benchmark cases |
| Prompt optimization | Yes (GEPA, MIPROv2) | No. Prompt versions are manual | Low | Interesting future fit for Tutor prompt versions. Defer |
| Tracing and observability | Yes | No observability in the platform | Low here | Covered by the separate observability research doc |
| DAG | Yes | No | Low | Candidate for the Arduino rubric. See Task 5 doc |
| Confident AI cloud | Yes | No | None | Do not adopt. Privacy and self-hosting constraints |
| Custom judge model wiring | Yes | No. Judge model config absent | High | Prerequisite for all LLM-judge metrics |
| CO2 and latency estimates | No | Yes. Bitcraft adds these | None (Bitcraft ahead) | Keep. Complements DeepEval |

## 5. Prioritized Recommendations

### P0 (do first)

1. **Register the built LLM-judge scorer.** The sidecar already contains `deepeval.llm_judge_benchmark`. Wire a judge model config that maps a Bitcraft interaction model into `DeepEvalBaseLLM`. Default to a local Ollama judge. Rough effort: small. Sidecar wiring, registration flag, and tests.
2. **Pass retrieval context into scoring.** Extend the tutor benchmark case payload with the Knowledge retrieval context. This enables Faithfulness and Answer Relevancy. Rough effort: small to medium.

### P1 (next iteration)

1. **True RAG metrics.** Replace token-overlap faithfulness with DeepEval FaithfulnessMetric when a judge is configured. Keep the deterministic scorer as a no-judge fallback. Rough effort: medium.
2. **Judge-based safety pass.** Add PIILeakage, Bias, and Toxicity as a second pass behind the existing regex scan. Rough effort: small once P0 lands.
3. **Multi-turn case capture.** Extend `BenchmarkRun` cases to store conversation turns. Add Role Adherence and Knowledge Retention scoring. Rough effort: medium. Needs a privacy review for stored conversations.
4. **Golden Synthesizer on Documents.** Generate seed cases from the existing Knowledge corpus. Rough effort: small to medium.

### P2 (later)

1. **DAG metric for the Arduino rubric.** Decide against G-Eval in the Task 5 options doc. Rough effort: medium.
2. **Conversation Simulator scenarios.** Build scripted tutoring scenarios for repeatable evals. Rough effort: medium.
3. **Tool Correctness and MCP metrics.** Wait for tutor tool-calling benchmarks. Rough effort: medium to large.
4. **Prompt optimization exploration.** Prototype PromptOptimizer against Tutor prompt versions. Rough effort: large.

## 6. Open Decisions

1. **Enable the implemented LLM-judge scorer now?**
   - Option A: Register it with a judge model config and local Ollama default.
   - Option B: Keep it deferred until multi-turn cases exist.
   - Option C: Remove the code.
   - Recommendation: A. The code exists. A judge unlocks G-Eval, RAG metrics, and judge-based safety metrics.
2. **Which judge models may score tutors?**
   - Option A: Local Ollama models only.
   - Option B: Any registered interaction model, admin-chosen per run.
   - Option C: Cloud models allowed too.
   - Recommendation: B with local-first defaults. Judge quality drives metric quality. Keep cloud opt-in per privacy policy.
3. **First metric family after the judge is live?**
   - Option A: RAG metrics (Faithfulness, Answer Relevancy).
   - Option B: Multi-turn tutoring metrics.
   - Option C: Judge-based safety metrics.
   - Recommendation: A then C. Both reuse the single-turn pipeline. B needs schema work first.
4. **How do we get multi-turn cases?**
   - Option A: Record real tutor conversation turns into benchmark cases.
   - Option B: Simulate conversations with the Conversation Simulator.
   - Recommendation: A first with consent and privacy review. B as a follow-up for scenario coverage.
5. **G-Eval or DAG for the Arduino rubric?**
   - Options: G-Eval, DAG, hybrid.
   - Recommendation: G-Eval first for speed. Move to DAG if scores flake. Final call belongs to the Task 5 options doc.
6. **Approve deepeval.com as a documentation source?**
   - `approved-external-sources.yaml` is currently empty. This research used a session-granted exception.
   - Recommendation: Add deepeval.com to the approved list. DeepEval docs are a recurring dependency.
